title: 3357. Minimize the Maximum Adjacent Element Difference

examples.explanation: By choosing the pair as (6, 7), nums can be changed to [1, 2, 6, 10, 8]. The absolute differences between adjacent elements are: |1 - 2| == 1 |2 - 6| == 4 |6 - 10| == 4 |10 - 8| == 2
By choosing the pair as (4, 4), nums can be changed to [4, 4, 4].
By choosing the pair as (11, 9), nums can be changed to [11, 10, 9, 8].
